Most important is protein. Getting enough will help you keep muscle on a caloric deficit. I like getting a little more than 2g of protein per kg of body weight.

Fat is important too. Getting enough fat will help keep your hormones normal. You don't want your hormones to get too messed up.

Carbs are more of a wild card. Some people cut them out entirely and have a lot of luck. Not my thing, but some love the "keto" style.

If you know how much protein and fat you want to eat, and how many calories you need to eat in order to lose weight, that is easy math again.
